comment: The named cast: one entry per fixed post, and every one of them a real character. A named bot has its own ServUO Account (banned, so no human can log in on it, and tagged GG.PlayerBot), is written by the world save like a player, goes OFFLINE at session end rather than being deleted, and is never destroyed (Sean, 21 and 22 September 2026, CLASS-DECISION.md). Throwaway bots are everyone else, come from GG_BotPop.xml spawners and own nothing durable. IDENTITY IS THE POOL NAME A BOT WAS BORN WITH: the account is named after it. To rename a bot, change name and set renamedFrom to the pool name it had - the account and the character stay the same and only the display name moves. A name must be in pool unless its renamedFrom is. class is a BotClass (never the legacy Crafter); home is a town from bots.json destinations.towns; post is a nav destination in that town, either a bank (any class, a crowd of several) or a craft station whose trade is this class (one each). female picks the body, because a name chosen for fit needs a body that fits it. The file is refused whole on any error and the previous roster is kept; a post the graph cannot place refuses only that entry, which stays offline and is reported on Bots.Named - it is never deleted. Removing an entry retires the bot: it stays offline in the save for ever, like a player who quit.
